decisions.evidence: The original marked-only correction proof invoked the discrete cell residual bound on unmarked adjacent cells without fine-space interior tests. The compatible two-triangle refinement refutes that test availability, not the theorem inequality itself. Root authorized the coherent patch-expanded method and explicit patch-pattern antecedent; fixed reference cell hats on every neighbor and full-tent edge liftings are prolonged to the fine mesh, so both incident residuals are now controlled. The estimator, contraction and optimality conclusions and original bulk marks are retained. This is the completed supplier-first owner resolution by /root/scope34_hdiv_owner, with all actual old/current consumers checked; the original native report remains an escalation handoff. No new native Alpha, reader, refuter, judge or gate execution is claimed. Root alone performs current-byte bindings and mechanical integration.
